newsitem.title: USA: WOOLWORTH SAYS Q2 EARNINGS TO MEET ANALYSTS' VIEWS.
newsitem.headline: WOOLWORTH SAYS Q2 EARNINGS TO MEET ANALYSTS' VIEWS.

text.p: Woolworth Corp said Thursday that despite lower than anticipated sales during the past two months, it expects second quarter earnings to meet analysts' consensus estimates.
The retailer, which announced three weeks ago that it was closing all its five and dime stores, said it expects to report second quarter earnings by August 14.
First Call's latest consensus earnings per share estimate for Woolworth's second quarter is $0.18.

Woolworth said that excluding the effect of translation rates, particularly as it relates to its German operations, sales for the four-week period dropped 3.0 percent, while sales for the year-to-date period covering 26 weeks rose 1.3 percent.
It said businesses sold during 1996 and 1997 have been excluded from all calculations.
